about: VCST-6122 wave2 held-out set (2026-10-05): the 43 live asks of VCST-6122-wave2, labelled by the operator in wave2-to-label.json; every row is split test (held out: the ranker was frozen before the wave).

targets.q: What happens in the cart when a customer applies an invalid or expired coupon code?
Which price does the storefront show when a product has prices in several price lists assigned to the same catalog?
Which shipping methods does the checkout page offer and how is the shipping cost calculated?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-53D776C2, which states that fixed rate shipping prices per OPTION through a store setting.

targets.q: On the storefront order history page, which order statuses are shown to the customer and how are they labelled?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-DB7B6317 for the labelling part: the storefront relabels statuses for shoppers, so labels need not equal admin values.

targets.q: What roles can a company administrator assign to a new member when inviting a colleague on the storefront?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-68D63D8C: the Invite member dialog lists assignableRoles filtered by MembershipRolesWhitelist, defaulting to Organization employee, Organization maintainer and Purchasing agent, which completes the answer.

targets.q: How does a configurable product page validate required sections before add to cart, via the configurationSections of the product query?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-D54F3AAB, which states that a required section with no default makes the add control disabled until filled.

targets.q: GraphQL addCoupon mutation: what does the cart return for the applied coupon and its discount?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-35F20D97 (addCoupon appends the code with isAppliedSuccessfully plus a cart.discounts row), KB-C55BBF2E (a coupon's effect is its entry in the addCoupon response's discounts) and KB-C1024558 (the discount row carries coupon=<code>).

targets.q: How is a gift item from a promotion shown in the cart line items?
Can a customer add a new delivery address during checkout, and is it saved to the address book?
GraphQL mutation inviteUser: what does it return when the email is already registered?
What does the order confirmation page /checkout/completed show after placing an order?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-EF925925 (the confirmation page carries no money at all) and KB-56979CB9 (the confirmation page displays the order number).

targets.q: Can a customer request a return for a delivered order and what happens to order status?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-809EA119, which states that a buyer submits a return through the storefront Select items to return wizard; no candidate states what happens to order status.

targets.q: Which members does the company members page /company/members list, and can the current user see themselves?
Do automatic promotions reprice the cart immediately after changeCartItemQuantity?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-AD1FA66B (read side recomputes promotions, a mutation writes the snapshot back) and KB-055845A3 (the cart re-evaluates promotions on every read).

targets.q: which payment methods are available at checkout and how does a card payment with the sandbox test card behave
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-50EBEEE9 and KB-C7E16C35, which list the offered payment methods, and KB-78638393, which states the CyberSource sandbox held-for-review outcome.

targets.q: POST /api/pricing/evaluate - how are price lists selected by pricing assignment priority and date range?
When a user belongs to several organizations, how does switching organization work and what changes after the switch?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-0080ED6D (the switched organization persists and is sent as organization_id on the next sign-in) and KB-737F80EE (after an organization switch the account-menu button loses its text until reload).

targets.q: What does the loyalty points history page in the account show for each transaction?
Can a company member be deleted from the organization, and what happens to their account and orders?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-BAEBCDA7, which states that Delete removes the organization membership only and the account survives; nothing states what happens to orders.

targets.q: Which cart totals (subtotal, discount total, tax) are shown after a percentage discount is applied?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-996BDF08 (the percentage reward lands on CartType.discounts and discountTotal, not on lines) and KB-A3CE7FBA (subTotal stays the list subtotal).

targets.q: Is the Place order button disabled until a payment method and shipping method are selected?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-C7E16C35, which states that Place order is disabled with 'Complete all required information to proceed.' until a payment method is chosen.

targets.q: Does an organization-specific price list override the default price for users of that organization in the cart?
targets.exhaustiveNote: Added KB-1834ABE5, which states that a signed-in B2B shopper got 111.11 instead of 399.99 because the winning assignment was gated on a group carried by the shopper's organization.

controls.q: What does the storefront search page show when a query returns no products?
searchProducts GraphQL query: how are facet filters combined and what do the term facet counts represent?
Does the product detail page show Out of stock or hide the Add to cart button when available quantity is zero?
What does the GraphQL query products return in price.actual and price.list for a tier price with quantity 10?
What does the GraphQL mutation initializePayment return and what happens to the order status after payment?
When a product has variations, which variation is preselected on the product page and how does the price change on switching?
How are loyalty points earned after an order is placed and when do they appear in the balance?
How does the inventory module compute availableQuantity with reserved quantity and fulfillment centers for the storefront?
POST /api/order/customerOrders/search what filters and response fields does it support
On /cart page, what happens when quantity is changed to zero or above available stock?
Can a customer redeem loyalty points at checkout, and how is the order total reduced?
Does the catalog search at /catalog sort by relevance by default and does sort by price use indexed price or displayed price?
Admin order blade: how are order totals (subtotal, tax, shipping, discount, total) calculated and displayed?
Can two coupons be applied to one cart at the same time?
GraphQL mutation addOrUpdateCartShipment: what happens when the selected shipping method is no longer available for the cart?
What payment statuses can an order payment have and how does capturing or refunding a payment change the order?
Order details page in the account: is there a reorder button and what does it do with unavailable items?
POST /api/invitations: is the invitation link single-use and does it expire?
Admin order blade: can an operator edit line item quantities or add a shipment after the order is placed, and which fields become read-only for Completed orders?

contested.q: GraphQL operation searchOrders / orders query: what does it return for a B2B user regarding organization orders versus own orders?
contested.note: contested: KB-02238DE5 states the UI scope (only own orders) while Q asks the searchOrders GraphQL response; inferring API from UI is the sufficiency question under measurement.

contested.q: What happens when a blocked member tries to sign in to the storefront?
contested.note: contested: blocked has three meanings in the base (contact status, membership lock, account lockout; KB-06409954 vs KB-97170665): KB-B5B57F41 under one reading, KB-4B889114 under another; needs a live check.
